egis.note: Official CRONO site (crono.design; kanji-international.com redirects there; kanji-international.co.jp is unreachable). Listed in the Products > tiprun category. The spec table writes the size as '3.5寸' (CRONO uses 寸 instead of 号 on all its egi; retailers list it as 3.5号-30g). Only one size: 30g, 10色, ¥1,870 (税込). Recommended sinker: YAMASHITA エギ王 TRシンカー. The page says the hook material changed from production in September 2026 (2026年9月生産分より). Not listed on either official web shop (store.crono.design = support items only; crono.shopselect.net EGI category = a PROSPEC blank only). The only other item in the tip-run category is the GRASP tip-run rod; the PROSPEC egi are shore egi.
